agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Receipt fields use only closed dispositions and reachability values, declare every configured adapter and leave Git identity binding to the machine snapshot.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first receipt used descriptive non-admitted values, omitted two configured adapters and manually repeated full Git IDs in the machine-owned Git evidence field.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The orchestrator preflight returned revision_required with exact reason codes before plan freeze, process launch or state mutation.

correction.action: Use the configured closed disposition/reachability vocabulary, include all six adapters and remove caller-authored Git IDs from narrative Git evidence.
correction.prevention_control: The preflight remains the executable enum and machine-Git gate; a rejected receipt is preserved and cannot authorize planning.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects the rejected preplanning receipt vocabulary and machine-Git binding lapse before any execution.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A predecessor-only active-latch equality is explicitly selected out before replay while every substantive predecessor assertion remains selected.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first inherited run replayed the predecessor's exact active-operation equality after the latch had validly advanced, producing one expected failure before the selection was recorded.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The serial inherited pytest gate reported exactly one latch-operation mismatch and all other selected assertions passed.

correction.action: Record and test the exact predecessor-only node deselection while retaining the rest of the inherited file.
correction.prevention_control: Every successor gate names historical live-latch equality selections before executing inherited plan tests.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the exact predecessor-latch equality selection without weakening substantive inherited coverage.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A one-attempt controller validates its schema-valid consumed success terminal idempotently after launch without suggesting or starting another attempt.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first controller admitted only the no-artifact preflight state and therefore lacked a success-terminal readback branch after its one process passed.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Postterminal review identified that the focused test's no-artifact assertion would reject the now-valid canonical success artifacts; no rerun was attempted.

correction.action: Validate the exact consumed identity, schema-valid passing evidence, expected observation, cleanup and report marker idempotently.
correction.prevention_control: Every one-attempt controller owns both no-artifact preflight and every admitted terminal readback branch before closeout.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: adds idempotent success-terminal readback without a second native process.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Implementation hashes are read from exact repository paths without manually changing separator vocabulary inside filenames.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: One read-only hash command substituted hyphens for underscores in the focused-test filename and failed before the exact path was rerun.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Get-Item and Get-FileHash returned path-not-found; no file or Git state changed.

correction.action: Repeat the read from the exact repository filename and bind the resulting full digest in the contract.
correction.prevention_control: Derive implementation binding paths from controller constants or exact file inventory rather than retyping filenames.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records a contained read-only path spelling lapse and the exact-path correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Git object readback uses a shell-safe exact argument form and returns one full object ID per requested commit.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: A read-only PowerShell command supplied the revision peeling suffix without shell-safe quoting, allowing PowerShell to reinterpret it and produce rejected arguments.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: git rev-parse returned fatal ambiguous-argument diagnostics; a subsequent plain exact commit resolution returned the three full IDs without state change.

correction.action: Resolve already-known commit abbreviations with plain git rev-parse arguments and consume the returned 40-character IDs.
correction.prevention_control: Use machine-owned full IDs from receipts/evidence or quote Git revision expressions as literal arguments in PowerShell.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records a contained PowerShell Git-suffix lapse and machine-resolved full-ID correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A completed immutable success-terminal readback is independent of ambient npm-cache discovery; only an unexecuted preflight needs a supplied or discovered cache root.

correction.prevention_control: Provider-free terminal-readback tests run under the sanitized environment and assert the recorded cache-package count.
